[EN] Ramsleigh! He's still alive! I need to patch him up before the dragons come back!
[ES] ¡Ramsleigh! ¡Todavía está vivo! ¡Tengo que curarlo antes de que regresen los dragones!

[EN] There are so many plants nearby.
They shouldn't be far from here.
[ES] Hay tantas plantas cerca.
No deberían estar lejos de aquí.
